idea-plugin.name: Modern CSS Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Live templates for modern CSS that you can use today: every template states its Baseline browser-support status. Works in CSS, SCSS, Less and <style> blocks (HTML, Vue). Type an abbreviation such as css-container-query and press Tab.

Templates

  • Layout: css-container-query
  • Typography: css-fluid-type
  • Architecture: css-layers, css-component-scope

Usage

Type the abbreviation and press Tab; press Tab again to move between the editable fields. Ctrl+J / ⌘J lists all templates. Customize them under Settings | Editor | Live Templates | Modern CSS Toolkit.

Privacy

The plugin collects no data and makes no network requests.

Source code: github.com/jamesmosq/modern-css-toolkit.
